entities.summary: Alan Timothy Hardy is an American former professional basketball shooting guard who played two seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Los Angeles Lakers (1980–81) and the Detroit Pistons (1981–82). He attended the University of Michigan.
